relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Several studies have revealed that the administration of TRPV1 or TRPA1 agonists/antagonists and TRPV1 or TRPA1 knockdown reduced sensitivity to nociception in cancer pain models.

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: To date, only resiniferatoxin, a TRPV1 agonist, has been evaluated in clinical trials for cancer pain and showed preliminary positive results.

key_findings: TRPV1 and TRPA1 contribute to cancer pain in bone, paw, mammary fat pad and sciatic nerve tumour models; TRPV1 expression enhanced in some CIBP models.
